observations.basis: Pinned generated endpoint documentation at v17.0.0.
observations.statement: The merge operation exposes an optional sha value whose semantic role is that the pull-request head must match it to allow merge.

observations.basis: Semantic interpretation of the pinned must-match precondition; unrelated merge blockers are held outside the bounded model.
observations.statement: Within an otherwise-mergeable bounded world, a supplied reviewed sha matching the current pull-request head permits the guarded merge operation to proceed.

observations.basis: Pinned must-match precondition, corroborated by current official GitHub REST documentation specifying HTTP 409 Conflict for this mismatch.
observations.statement: When sha is supplied and the pull-request head does not match, the guarded merge must not be treated as a successful merge of the reviewed head.

official_documentation_corroboration.parameter_semantics: sha: SHA that pull request head must match to allow merge.

response_semantics.409: Conflict if sha was provided and pull request head did not match

subject.operation: GitHub REST merge a pull request
